floorPlans.introduction: Compare the published one- and two-bedroom drawings with floor keys and balcony dimensions.
floorPlans.note: The drawings show room dimensions. The total area varies by unit and is not printed on these sheets. Confirm the signed area for your apartment.

review.images: Eight native images from the Evergreens branded brochure. The lead shows the Evergreens elevations. The brochure publishes some of the same interior renders used in other DAMAC Hills 2 launches.
review.location: The branded site map and launch factsheet place Evergreens near the mall. Madena and JRE publish a matching coordinate, but it is not verified as the entrance. Named directions use the project identity.
review.floorPlans: Both original brochure plans include the complete floor keys. Property Finder lists matching Type A drawings for both bedroom counts without area values. The launch unit table has varying areas and is not a single exact total for either illustrated layout.

unavailable: Exact signed area for each apartment.
